title: Restyle route height rail as slider
summary: Restyle the Settings route height boundary editor to resemble a compact dual-thumb slider while preserving direct height input and existing settings keys.
reason: The segmented colored rail is functional but visually heavy; the operator requested a cleaner slider reference with draggable handles and direct numeric entry.
behavior_before: The editable route height rail appeared as three large colored rectangular bucket segments with inline boundary inputs embedded in the end segments.
behavior_after: The editable route height rail appears as a compact slider-style control with a muted track, colored bucket fills, circular draggable handles, and inline boundary value chips.
